title: Bake-off scores (THROWAWAY)
description: docs/bakeoff/scores.json: Sami's judging comment transcribed by the lead; `bakeoff decide` applies the rule in docs/bakeoff/judging.md to it.

source.description: URL of the judging comment this file transcribes.

prefers_c_over_a.description: Asked only when no D lane got would_ship: yes.

lanes.description: Both D lanes must be present (a blocked one as would_ship: false with null scores): leaving one out could flip the decision.

score.description: 1-5, or null for a lane Sami could not score (a blocked lane with nothing to judge).

then.description: A lane Sami would ship has all three scores: they decide the engine.
